channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Oil prices soar on fears of long supply disruption, US siege of Iran ports
item.description: US President Trump meets with oil firms over ways to minimise impact on fuel supplies amid US blockade of Iranian ports.

item.title: Pro-government rally in Tehran demands end to US threats
item.description: Hundreds of Iranians have rallied in Tehran to demand an end to US threats and the ongoing blockade of Iranian ports.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump urges Tehran to ‘give up’; Ghalibaf mocks US strategy
item.description: Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf ridicules US's economic pressure campaign as oil prices surge and Hormuz standoff continues.

item.title: Trump: Putin offered to help settle Iranian nuclear enrichment impasse
item.description: Donald Trump said that Vladimir Putin told him he’d “like to be involved” in settling Iranian nuclear enrichment.

item.title: Oil jumps to highest price since 2022 after report Trump to be briefed on new Iran options
item.description: Axios reported that US Central Command has prepared a plan for a wave of "short and powerful" strikes on Iran.

item.title: Hegseth clashes with lawmakers over Iran war in nearly six-hour-long hearing
item.description: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth sparred with Democratic lawmakers during a nearly six-hour-long hearing, in his first time facing questions under oath since the start of the Iran war.

item.title: Former US officials criticise Pentagon silence on deadly Iran school attack
item.description: In the two months since the deadly strike, the US defence department has said only that the incident is under investigation.

item.title: Israeli 'double-tap' strike kills three rescue workers in Lebanon, officials say
item.description: They are among nine people killed in successive attacks on Tuesday, which Israel's military says targeted a Hezbollah commander.

item.title: Four key takeaways from Jerome Powell's final rate decision as Fed chair
item.description: Powell's news conference after holding rates covered the US-Israel war with Iran, inflation, legal attacks, and the Fed's independence.

item.title: 'Attacked 28 times in a day' - BBC visits heavily targeted US-UK base in Iraq
item.description: Before the fragile ceasefire in the region, this was one of the most heavily targeted US and UK military bases in the Middle East.
